description: Machine-friendly NL2SQL guide for the M6 manufacturing module.

join_hints.name: bom_structure_flow
join_hints.description: Relationship from the BOM header to input and output components.

join_hints.name: mrs_to_mrn_flow
join_hints.description: Relationship from material request slips to material receipt notes.

join_hints.name: mrs_to_pd_flow
join_hints.description: Relationship from material request slips to production documents.

join_hints.name: bom_pdr_wo_reference_flow
join_hints.description: Relationship among manufacturing documents that cross-reference BOM, PDR, and WO.

join_hints.name: workorder_material_output_flow
join_hints.description: Relationship from work orders to input detail, output detail, activity, and route cards.

detail_lineage_keys.usage: Trace input components to the BOM header.
Trace output/result rows to the BOM header.
Trace consumed material to the MRS header.
Trace MRN material realization back to the source MRS.
Trace production-document output back to the source MRS.
Trace input production-result lines to the PDR header.
Trace output production-result lines to the PDR header.
Trace material-requirement lines to the work-order header.
Trace finished-output lines to the work-order header.
Trace process-activity lines to the work-order header.
Trace route-card lines to the work-order header.

important_rules: Use header tables for document numbers, dates, warehouses, statuses, and process references.
Use `_in` and `_out` detail tables for material inputs, finished outputs, and realized quantities.
Use history tables only when the user explicitly asks for document history or audit changes.
For production-flow tracing, start from detail tables when the question concerns material realization or output.
M6 documents reference BOM, PDR, and WO heavily; make sure the source-process context is not mixed up.

query_patterns.name: material_realization_trace
query_patterns.pattern: Start from `m6_mrs_out` and connect it to `m6_mrn_out` or `m6_pd_out`.

query_patterns.name: work_order_trace
query_patterns.description: Trace work orders and their activities.

caution_areas: Questions that mix BOM, WO, PDR, and PD without a clear document relationship.
Questions that combine history tables with active tables without a clear audit purpose.
Questions that rely on `custom*` fields or snapshot tables such as `m6_itembom_in/out` without context.
